title: Photo and Ultrasound Facilitated the Release of Nitric Oxide From [Ru(NO)(QnCN)(Pro)Cl] Isomers: Synthesis, Cytotoxicity, DNA Binding, and Theoretical Simulation.
authors: Liu, Chenyang; Wu, Tao; Liu, Yuhua; Jiao, Shuxiang; Qin, Chenjie; Wang, Juanjuan; Xie, Leilei; Wang, Wenming; Wang, Hongfei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钌配合物的NO释放、细胞毒性与DNA小沟结合，虽含分子对接和DNA结合，但对象为小分子-核酸互作而非蛋白质-DNA体系，方法仅简单对接，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Four isomers of [Ru(NO)(QnCN)(Pro)Cl] (L1, D1, L2, and D2) were synthesized, where QnCN is 8-hydroxy-2-quinolinecarbonitrile and Pro is L- or D- proline. Complexes L1 and D1, L2 and D2 are two pairs of Ru-centered enantiomers. In L1 and D1, the proline is coordinated trans to NO, whereas in L2 and D2 the 8-hydroxy-2-quinolinecarbonitrile is coordinated trans to NO. The electronic absorption spectra, infrared (IR), and Raman spectra of the isomers were experimentally measured and theoretically assigned. Ultrasound induces the release of NO from the complexes in solution more rapidly, with a shorter t(1/2) than light does. Moreover, the cytotoxicity of the isomeric complexes against HeLa cells was evaluated; the IC(50) values range from 1 to 10 microM, with selectivity indices exceeding 2.8. The complexes induced apoptosis in HeLa cells and arrested the cell cycle at the G2/M phase. Molecular docking analyses have revealed that the complexes interact with DNA via minor groove binding. The unique stereochemical configurations of the four complexes affect their selective binding to CT-DNA, with DNA binding affinities at 298 K in the following order: D1 > D2 > L1 > L2. This study offers insights into the potential applications of these isomeric nitrosylruthenium complexes.
abstract_zh: 合成了四种[Ru(NO)(QnCN)(Pro)Cl]异构体（L1、D1、L2和D2），其中QnCN为8-羟基-2-喹啉甲腈，Pro为L-或D-脯氨酸。配合物L1和D1、L2和D2是两对Ru中心对映异构体。在L1和D1中，脯氨酸与NO反式配位，而在L2和D2中，8-羟基-2-喹啉甲腈与NO反式配位。实验测量了异构体的电子吸收光谱、红外（IR）和拉曼光谱，并进行了理论归属。超声诱导溶液中配合物释放NO的速度比光更快，且t(1/2)更短。此外，评估了异构体配合物对HeLa细胞的细胞毒性；IC(50)值范围为1至10微摩尔，选择性指数超过2.8。这些配合物诱导HeLa细胞凋亡，并将细胞周期阻滞在G2/M期。分子对接分析表明，这些配合物通过小沟结合与DNA相互作用。四种配合物的独特立体化学构型影响它们对CT-DNA的选择性结合，298 K下的DNA结合亲和力顺序为：D1 > D2 > L1 > L2。本研究为这些异构体亚硝酰钌配合物的潜在应用提供了见解。
